body:
## Changes
- Add a short, optional consequence/boundary lead-selection heuristic. Honor prompt-scoped leads, check equivalent entry points, and preserve the three-lead ceiling as a maximum, not a quota.
- Turn unresolved consequential findings into proposed discriminating observations: trigger, oracle, supporting result, and meaningful refuting alternative. Direct documentation contradictions don't require runtime tests.
- Add optional recipes, README context, regression guardrails, and an evaluation protocol for fresh matched and independently reviewed comparisons.

## Evidence and caveats
Field findings on pg-trickle informed this hypothesis, but the prompts were already targeted and refined follow-ups came from later triage. We **cannot claim improved effectiveness** from those examples. Issues #6 and #7 should remain open pending independent matched trials; revert/simplify the guidance if its value does not justify overhead. Closed #4/#5 had intentionally narrowed criteria; Claude Code and complete effectiveness qualification should not be inferred.

## Validation
Awaiting GitHub CI (standard skill tests and skills CLI install matrix). No runtime audit comparison has been performed as part of this PR.

Related: #6, #7.
title: Experiment with risk-guided scouting and verification-ready findings (#6, #7)
